candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis specifies 'primary cutaneous embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma,' requiring both the embryonal subtype (supported by histopathology showing small round blue cells with MyoD1/myogenin positivity and the clinical presentation) and the primary cutaneous qualifier (verrucous plaque arising in skin without systemic disease). C001 names only 'rhabdomyosarcoma of right frontotemporal region,' which is a parent-level diagnosis lacking the embryonal subtype and the critical primary cutaneous designation.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies rhabdomyosarcoma at the correct anatomical site but omits the subtype (embryonal) and the primary cutaneous origin designation

case_quality_flags: Histopathology and IHC strongly support embryonal subtype; alveolar subtype not excluded by molecular testing (FOXO1 FISH not mentioned), but morphology and MyoD1/myogenin pattern are consistent with embryonal
Primary cutaneous origin supported by clinical presentation (gradual superficial growth, no systemic involvement, no deep soft-tissue mass on imaging beyond skin/subcutaneous thickening)
